Institutions

Become a Partner

Universities, governments, companies, CSOs, and funders — partnership is the platform's core mechanic. Tell us who you are and what you want to build; the partnerships team responds within two weeks.

  • → Research collaboration & academic mobility
  • → Innovation, enterprise & investment partnerships
  • → Policy advisory & institutional cooperation
  • → Funding & development partnerships

Or write directly: info@gpsouth.org

Individuals & institutions

Join the Network

Researchers, practitioners, founders, artists, students, diaspora professionals — join to receive the Dialogues invitations, opportunity alerts, and the Outlook at launch.

Structured belonging

Membership

Formal membership categories — designed now, activated when the Board opens enrollment (expected with the 2027 launch cycle).
